description.value: The passionate love of Catherine Earnshaw and Heathcliff mirrors the powerful moods of the Yorkshire moors.

Set against the dark and rugged moorlands of northern England, WUTHERING HEIGHTS introduces two of the most startling characters in literature: Heathcliff, an unfathomable mixture of savagery and gentleness; and Catherine, the woman he loved but drove to madness. This classic, unforgettable novel has truly been called "the strangest love story ever told."
